headline: One photo, 177 different works
reasons: The same photo file (fingerprint 6e4604abb965) is attached to 177 different works in 4 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 177 separate works.
The works are recorded as: Contour Trench (177).
These works are spread over 4 blocks: Dakore, Kadaura, Kuthaund, Maheva.
